text:
jordan (eng-platform): Quick follow-up on yesterday's RFC — proposal to add an "audit_context" envelope to billing events so deferred audits are deterministic. Thoughts?

mike (billing): +1 on deterministic audits. Keep the envelope small though, worried about per-event size at 10k rps.

lee (eng-infra): We can compress or store the heavy fields as blobs and put a pointer in the event. Also suggest partitioning by tenant_id for locality.

sana (eng-ml): Need deterministic token attribution. For streaming responses we should emit a finalization event containing final token counts and attribution slices (model variant + token ranges).

mike (billing): How do we ensure idempotence for finalization? Streams can produce duplicates.

jordan (eng-platform): Plan: include an idempotency_key + sequence_id on every billing event. Finalization event will include sequence_end and is_final=true. Audit reads will use (tenant_id, session_id, sequence_id) ordering.

jordan (eng-platform): Example event sketch:
```
{
  "event_id": "evt_01F...",
  "idempotency_key": "tenant123.session456.seq789",
  "tenant_id": "tenant123",
  "user_id": "u_321",
  "model": "llama-3b-v1",
  "token_counts": {"total": 142, "prompt": 48, "completion": 94},
  "attribution": [{"slice_start": 0, "slice_end": 47, "policy": "per_prompt"}],
  "audit_context": {"blob_ptr": "s3://billing-audits/2026/evt_01F..."},
  "is_final": true
}
```

lee (eng-infra): Proposed Kafka topics: billing.events (partition=tenant_id hash), billing.audit_blobs (object store pointers, compacted), billing.late.arrivals (for out-of-order/fallback). Use compaction on blobs topic with key=billing_key.

mike (billing): Important: choose a stable "billing_key" for joins: tenant_id + session_id + seq_start. TTL for blobs = 90d; audit retention policy separate.

sana (eng-ml): Add regression hook: if attribution changes after model variant swap, flag record and route to manual review queue. Also include provenance_hash in audit_context.

jordan (eng-platform): Decision for short-term: implement audit_context pointer + finalization event + idempotency_key. Backfill window: run 2-week backfill for recent sessions. I'll open follow-up RFC with exact schema and rollout plan.

lee (eng-infra): :thumbsup: I'll prototype topic configs and compaction policy, plus a small kafka connector to write blobs to S3.

mike (billing): I'll update downstream billing joins to consume finalization semantics and tolerate late.arrivals topic.

metering-bot: schema push queued: metering.billing.v2 -> staging
